notes.title: Interface update
notes.content:
Hello, fellow Facesit Inc. - lovers, 

We completely reforged the interface for the game. The new "rocky" main theme is furnished with viking-themes like axes and horns. 

New dialogue windows and game menu elements.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36637269/d0cee280a425be272ce0ab7f6008b1a6bd7eaee7.jpg

In-game choice buttons follow the style.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36637269/2cdfba4ed9ae2ec1ec40f047db12c2038b198711.jpg

The gallery was reworked in order for it to appear more like our other games. The images are now divided into the sections dedicated to different characters. 
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36637269/51ee10b655eedad079d36906f8801b8858236f41.png

Main menu got fancy buttons that are highlighted in gold when hovered.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36637269/748bc206a71ee7a7f43226f8520c544b2cb6db6f.png

That is the last major update we planned for Meowhalla right now.

notes.title: Update 1.2 is live!
notes.content:
With the current update we introduced the following changes.

Sprites:

Added fully remade sprites for all characters. 
Existing sprites now change each other more often. 
Astrid’s size was adjusted to correspond to the plot.
Sprites now displayed in two size versions rather than three.

Game changes:
Added new transitions between scenes and some of them were replaced with better alternatives.
Nude versions of some gallery items are placed in-game. (Previously available only in the unlockable gallery)

Sound:
Added explosion sound in the plane. 
Added bonfire sound in the camp.

Other:
Credits now specify, for which part of the game a person was responsible.
Added “options” button to in-game menu. Previously, it was available only in the quick menu.
Added “auto-play” button to the quick menu. The novel can now be read in an auto-mode.

Bug fixes:
Fixed issue when for some players ending screens were covered by dialogue screens.
Fixed typos and formatting in the “Credits” section.
Fixed issue when date and time of save files was not displayed in the Russian version.
Fixed minor typos in the Russian version.

notes.title: Our second game, M.A.I.D.s is coming soon on Steam!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=-DUIb4dh8_0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

We are ready to present our second game, M.A.I.D.s, a visual novel featuring humanized household items. We took into account mistakes and flaws of our previous game, hired a new artist and improved the overall quality.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36637269/403e660206777fe04f0f5a9c280d26fd32dfcff0.png

Four girls live in your household:

- Viki, a vacuum cleaner
- Daisy, a dishwasher
- Bee, a blender
- Diana, a dispenser

Expect a lot of jokes, rich story about the pandemic and sexy outfits. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36637269/60de114b020d8661b3176e3aca2cb3de1c2febef.png
